text: Hello, I hope this isn't a silly question to be sending this late. I'm a foster carer and the girl in my care is 11. She's had a temperature today, it was 38.2 when I checked it just now. She's been fine in herself really, eating a bit of tea, chatting with me while we watched telly, but tonight she just won't settle to sleep, keeps getting up and coming downstairs. Probably just feeling a bit rubbish. The reason I'm messaging is that when she came down the last time I noticed some spots on her arm and her side. They're tiny, like pinpricks, and some are darker, a sort of purple-red colour. I remembered reading about pressing a glass on them so I tried it and they're still there, they don't fade at all through the glass. I tried it a couple of times to make sure I wasn't doing it wrong. I don't want to overreact and I need to let her social worker know whatever happens, so I'd just like some advice on what I should be doing now.
